evidence: Carries the Validation label and modifies FlushStateToDisk in src/validation.cpp.
rationale: Stops writing coins cache entries and block-index metadata when block or undo data fails to flush to disk, preventing on-disk corruption. As noted in the discussion, when block data is stored on a separate filesystem (-blocksdir), continuing to advance m_last_flushed_block despite an fsync failure leaves metadata inconsistent with missing or corrupted block files.
